description: This file defines the Sqrt class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing functions to compute square roots and the square root of a number times pi. It includes methods for handling both scalar and array inputs, with validation and error handling.

classes.name: Sqrt
classes.description: Provides static methods for calculating square roots and related functions, supporting array and scalar inputs with validation.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.description: Calculates the square root of a number or array of numbers, with validation.

methods.name: pi
methods.description: Calculates the square root of the number multiplied by pi, with validation.
